7.4.93 explicitly limits san-like reduplicative changes to an-ag-lopa and gives अचकथत् as the excluded aglopin control. The i in the submitted reduplicative syllable is consequently unlicensed.

7.4.2 independently blocks caN shortening for aglopin stems; this additionally rejects BAma→Bam. Appropriate person/number endings attach to the source-supported unchanged reduplicative stem; they cannot restore the forbidden vowel changes.

kutadi-perfect-guna.claim: डिडेपिथ changes the i of the kutadi root डिप to e. Dhatupradipa scan121 places डिप in the kutadi section. 1.2.1 makes the non-nit/nit-exempt thal suffix ngit;1.1.5 blocks guna. डिडिपिथ follows. Ordinary non-kutadi perfect analogies do not override the specified class/entry.
kutadi-perfect-guna.evidence_level: Dhatupradipa scan121 lexical placement; Kashika1.2.1 and1.1.5.
kutadi-perfect-guna.limit: Bounded examination of this submitted answer; unsubmitted variants and complete accepted unions are not certified.

optative-person-ending.claim: कुथ्नीत lacks the required Parasmaipada optative ya element and is not the second-person-plural ending. 3.4.103 adds yasut,7.2.79 deletes its s,3.4.101 changes tha to ta;6.4.113 gives the short-class weak stem kuthni. Together कुथ्नीयात is obtained. A possible middle reading would require its own second-person-plural ending, not the submitted -ta.
optative-person-ending.evidence_level: Kashika commentaries on the listed rules; actual morphological coordinates.
optative-person-ending.limit: Bounded examination of this submitted answer; unsubmitted variants and complete accepted unions are not certified.

sr-aorist-commentary-scope.claim: Kashika3.1.56 expressly names सृ गतौ and prints असरत्, supporting an ang stem which regularly yields असरन्. Madhaviya restricts this ang rule to Juhotyadi sr by association with sas. The supplied task says Bhvadi but specifies no commentary school. The bounded review cannot settle whether the broader Kashika wording licenses the exact Bhvadi entry; neither accept nor reject solely from VP.
sr-aorist-commentary-scope.evidence_level: Kashika3.1.56 versus Madhaviya entry sR, reproduced at kosha.sanskrit.today/word/sa/sR; primary commentary conflict.
sr-aorist-commentary-scope.limit: Bounded examination of this submitted answer; unsubmitted variants and complete accepted unions are not certified.

dyai-ay-length.claim: The supplied root ends in ai. 6.1.78 maps ai to ay with LONG a (आय्) before the a-stem vowel, giving द्याय-. The submitted द्ययाम incorrectly shortens that stem; the first-person-plural imperative does not supply a rule for that shortening.
dyai-ay-length.evidence_level: Kashika6.1.78 explicitly gives ordered e/o/ai/au→ay/av/ay(long)/av(long); Dhatupradipa scan76 prints द्यायति.
dyai-ay-length.limit: Bounded examination of this submitted answer; unsubmitted variants and complete accepted unions are not certified.

rinv-natva.claim: रिरिन्व retains dental n. The supplied idit root adds num and the same-word earlier r triggers natva across the permitted vowel/v interveners under8.4.1–2, giving रिरिण्व. The frozen optional-gemination policy cannot change n to n retroflex or remove the required natva.
rinv-natva.evidence_level: Kashika8.4.1–2 plus literal idit root and actual perfect form.

durv-lengthening.claim: दुर्वतः retains short u before the root-internal rv cluster. 8.2.78 extends the r/v lengthening to the root-internal position and directly illustrates urvi/dhurvi; the analogous supplied durvi requires दूर्वतः. Dhatupradipa scan53 also prints दूर्वति.
durv-lengthening.evidence_level: Kashika8.2.78; primary lexical representative in Dhatupradipa scan53.
durv-lengthening.limit: Bounded examination of this submitted answer; unsubmitted variants and complete accepted unions are not certified.

cell-lexical-geminate.claim: चेलानि deletes one lexical l from the supplied cella citation. Primary Dhatupradipa scans51–52 separately list cela and cella and print चेल्लति. Optional deletion8.4.64 requires a preceding consonant; the first l here follows e, so it does not license cell→cel. Adding an optional third l then deleting it likewise never licenses a singleton.
cell-lexical-geminate.evidence_level: Primary separate lexical entries in Dhatupradipa51–52 and Kashika8.4.64–65.
cell-lexical-geminate.limit: Bounded examination of this submitted answer; unsubmitted variants and complete accepted unions are not certified.

kand-lexical-accent-pada.claim: कण्डिष्ये uses middle. kand-lexical-accent-pada.evidence_level: Dhatupradipa scan37 and primary Dhatupatha middle-section entry; possible task-source marker ambiguity.
